name: Shammai
overview: Shammai was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Mered and Bithia. His lineage is noted in 1 Chronicles 4:17, situating him within the genealogical records of Israel. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide additional details about his life or role.
namesAndTitles: The name Shammai means 'YHWH has heard,' reflecting a Hebrew proper name with a theologically significant meaning. This name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:17, was not given directly by God but carries a reminder of God's attentive nature.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Shammai as the son of Mered and Bithia, establishing his immediate family connections. No further familial relationships are detailed beyond these parents in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shammai's mention in the genealogies serves to preserve the heritage of the tribe of Judah, emphasizing God's providential care in maintaining His covenant people. His parentage, linking him to Mered and Bithia, highlights the inclusion of diverse individuals within Israel's history. Although not prominent in narrative events, his presence in Scripture contributes to the comprehensive record of God's chosen lineage.
